source.notes: in.attuned/in.unique are the root's PropertyInt.Attuned/Unique (null: unset). With in.contents the root is a Container holding those items (each with its own attuned/unique), else a GenericObject. in.traded lists the indices (0 the root, 1.. the contents) whose guids are in the trade-window set. out is [attuned, unique, being traded].
